CardContainment

The `m3e-card` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Anatomy

M3eelbuildHTML
M3e.card []
[ M3e.Card.header
(M3e.heading
[ M3e.Heading.variant M3e.Values.display
, M3e.Heading.size M3e.Values.small
]
[ Kit.text "Card Header" ]
)
, M3e.Card.content (TypedHtml.div [] [ Kit.text "Card Content" ])
, M3e.Card.actions (TypedHtml.div [] [ M3e.button [ M3e.Button.variant M3e.Values.filled ] [ Kit.text "Action" ] ])
, M3e.Card.footer (TypedHtml.div [] [ Kit.text "Card Footer" ])
]
M3e.Card.view []
[ M3e.Card.header
(M3e.Heading.el { content = Kit.text "Card Header" }
[ M3e.Heading.variant M3e.Values.display
, M3e.Heading.size M3e.Values.small
]
[]
)
, M3e.Card.content (TypedHtml.div [] [ Kit.text "Card Content" ])
, M3e.Card.actions
(TypedHtml.div []
[ M3e.Button.el
{ content = Kit.text "Action"
, action = M3e.Action.none
}
[ M3e.Button.variant M3e.Values.filled ]
[]
]
)
, M3e.Card.footer (TypedHtml.div [] [ Kit.text "Card Footer" ])
]
M3e.Card.build
|> M3e.Card.withHeader
(M3e.Heading.view
[ M3e.Heading.variant M3e.Values.display
, M3e.Heading.size M3e.Values.small
]
[ Kit.text "Card Header" ]
)
|> M3e.Card.withContent (TypedHtml.div [] [ Kit.text "Card Content" ])
|> M3e.Card.withActions (TypedHtml.div [] [ M3e.Button.view [ M3e.Button.variant M3e.Values.filled ] [ Kit.text "Action" ] ])
|> M3e.Card.withFooter (TypedHtml.div [] [ Kit.text "Card Footer" ])
|> M3e.Card.toElement
<m3e-card>
<m3e-heading slot="header" variant="display" size="small">Card Header</m3e-heading>
<div slot="content">Card Content</div>
<div slot="actions">
<m3e-button variant="filled">Action</m3e-button>
</div>
<div slot="footer">Card Footer</div>
</m3e-card>

Card Header (2)

M3eelbuildHTML
M3e.card [] [ Kit.text "Card content" ]

el is identical to the M3e tab for this example — its content has no required slots or attributes for the el surface to enforce, so it would be a hollow duplicate of M3e. Reach for el on an example whose composition it can hold a guarantee over.

|> M3e.Card.withChild (Kit.text "Card content")
|> M3e.Card.toElement

API

Constructor

view : List.List (HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr M3e.Component.Card.Attrs msg) -> List.List (HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts (M3e.Component.Card.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> HtmlIr.Element.Element (M3e.Component.Card.Is s) admittedBy msg

Standard constructor: [attributes] [children]. The default slot is kind-permissive (any): children of any kind compose, but each child's OWN admittedBy must still admit this context — a restricted-parent element is rejected here at compile time.

type Is

The kind row m3e-card produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

type Orientation

The orientation values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

type Type

The type_ values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

type Variant

The variant values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

Other

orientation : HtmlIr.Value.Value M3e.Component.Card.Orientation -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | orientation : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

The orientation of the card. (default: "vertical")

type_ : HtmlIr.Value.Value M3e.Component.Card.Type -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | type_ : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

The type of the element. (default: "button")

variant : HtmlIr.Value.Value M3e.Component.Card.Variant -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | variant : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

The appearance variant of the card. (default: "filled")

See M3e.Attributes.actionable.

See M3e.Attributes.disabled.

See M3e.Attributes.disabledInteractive.

download : String.String -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | download : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Attributes.download.

href : String.String -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | href : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Attributes.href.

inline : Basics.Bool -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | inline : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Attributes.inline.

name : String.String -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | name : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

The name of the element, submitted as a pair with the element's value as part of form data, when the element is used to submit a form.

rel : String.String -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | rel : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Attributes.rel.

target : String.String -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | target : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Attributes.target.

See M3e.Attributes.value.

See M3e.Attributes.defaultValue.

onClick : msg -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | onClick : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

See M3e.Events.onClick.

actions : HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named actions slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

content : HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named content slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

footer : HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named footer slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

header : HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named header slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

child : HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place a pre-built element into the default (unnamed) slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list). The list-form sibling of the builder's withChild.
